summary: Published as a detached eclipsing binary with a delta Scuti pulsating primary and P = 7.5952 d (Lee, Kristiansen & Hong 2019, arXiv 1904.07362), matching our 7.5954 d, and treated there as a binary rather than a triple/quadruple; the paper reports pulsation frequencies of 9.94-13.01 per day, and our second period of 0.2012 d equals twice the period of the 9.94 per day signal (2/9.94 = 0.2012 d), so it may be that pulsation rather than a second eclipsing binary.
